english_translation: Do you think it will rain tomorrow?
grammar_notes: Concordial Agreement (Zvivakashure): Notice how 'Unofunga' establishes the noun class/subject frame (2nd Person Sg Subject Concord (u-)).
Agglutinative Morphology: 'mangwana' combines prefixal/suffixal morphemes (ma- (2pl/hon subj past) + -ngwana (stem)) with tone contour H-L-H.
Penultimate Lengthening: In Zezuru declarative sentences, the second-to-last syllable of the phrase carries natural vowel lengthening.
cultural_notes: In Harare Zezuru standard speech, speakers maintain strict alliterative concord (zvivakashure) across noun classes while using respectful plural forms (hunhu).
